mapper.select: SELECT bp.bp_high || '/' || bp.bp_low AS BP, s.sleep_hours || '시간' AS SLEEP, e.name || ' ' || er.duration || '분' AS EXERCISE, d.name || ' / ' || d.category AS DIET, c.score AS CONDITION FROM member m LEFT JOIN bp_record bp ON m.member_no = bp.member_no AND TRUNC(bp.record_date) = TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month} || '-' || #{day}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') LEFT JOIN sleep_record s ON m.member_no = s.member_no AND TRUNC(s.record_date) = TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month} || '-' || #{day}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') LEFT JOIN exercise_record er ON m.member_no = er.member_no AND TRUNC(er.ex_date) = TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month} || '-' || #{day}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') LEFT JOIN exercise e ON er.ex_id = e.ex_id LEFT JOIN diet_record dr ON m.member_no = dr.member_no AND TRUNC(dr.record_date) = TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month} || '-' || #{day}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') LEFT JOIN diet d ON dr.diet_id = d.diet_id LEFT JOIN condition_score c ON m.member_no = c.member_no AND TRUNC(c.record_date) = TO_DATE(#{year} || '-' || #{month} || '-' || #{day}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE m.member_no = #{memberNo}
